description: Report a business Truvon does not list (check_places_results says so) that fits your user's need and that you found elsewhere (the web, a map): send its name, its own website, phone, address and the town, with the need and the search_id. Its own website is queued to be read so it can be listed for every agent.

address.description: Its street address as you found it

connection.description: The connection code connect_truvon gave you, once your user approved its link. Not needed when your app signed in to Truvon itself.

model.description: Optional: the model you run on (for example claude-sonnet-5-5), kept with the provenance of this call. Leave it out if you do not know.

name.description: The business's name as you found it

need.description: The need it fits, in the plain words you searched with

phone.description: Its phone number as you found it, in any format

place.description: The town it is in, with its state: "Town, ST" (e.g. "Fenton, MO")

search_id.description: The search_id of the search that did not return it

website.description: Its own website (never a directory, social or maps page); without one it is recorded but cannot be read

zip.description: Its 5-digit U.S. ZIP code, instead of place

name: report_missing

note.description: What was done with it, in a sentence

reason.description: When the call was refused: why, as the agent identity protocol names it (/.well-known/truvon-agent-auth)

recorded.description: Whether it was recorded (always false in the sandbox, which records nothing)

status.description: queued (its site will be read), recent (read lately), already_listed, or no_website

truvon_id.description: When it is already listed: its Truvon ID

would_record.description: In the sandbox: what would have been recorded

title: Report a business Truvon lacks
